ui.teamBridge.approvals.title.note: Names the list of approval requests teammates' agents sent the reader. Also the Team Bridge rail entry that opens it.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.intro.note: A teammate is a person; their agent is the AI agent acting for them. Keep the two words distinct; never say bare "team".

ui.teamBridge.approvals.waiting.note: The ONE singular/plural label for the request badge (spec request.badge). Say "waiting", not "pending approvals".

ui.teamBridge.approvals.nav_name.role: accessible name of the sidebar row while requests wait
ui.teamBridge.approvals.nav_name.note: {label} is the already-translated "N requests waiting" phrase. Team Bridge is a product name; keep it untranslated if the locale's glossary does.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.tab_waiting.note: Tab showing requests that still need an answer.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.tab_history.note: Tab showing past approve/deny decisions (an audit trail).

ui.teamBridge.approvals.select_all.note: Selects every request that can be decided, up to the batch limit.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.select_row.role: accessible name of a row checkbox
ui.teamBridge.approvals.select_row.note: {sender} is a teammate's or their agent's display name.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.approve_selected.note: Approves every selected request in one Touch ID confirmation.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.deny_selected.note: Denies every selected request in one Touch ID confirmation.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.approve_locked.note: An earlier approval was confirmed but has not reached the teammate. Only this same answer can be sent now.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.deny_locked.note: An earlier denial was confirmed but has not reached the teammate. Only this same answer can be sent now.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.reason_no_card.note: Explains why the row cannot be decided here.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.reason_not_open.note: Explains why the row cannot be decided here.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.received.note: {time} is a formatted date and time.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.authorizing.note: The system Touch ID prompt is open.

placeholders.notSent: number not sent; the second part disappears at zero

ui.teamBridge.approvals.results_title.note: Heading above the list of results after a decision, e.g. "2 decided · 1 not sent".

placeholders.names: Display names already joined into one list by Intl.ListFormat (conjunction); never inflected or split

ui.teamBridge.approvals.refusal.locked_n.note: {names} is a comma-separated list of display names.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.refusal.presence.note: Points the person to the per-request ask cards in their chat.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.unknown_sender.note: Used when a request's sender has no name or email.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.history.other.note: A decision whose state is neither approved nor denied.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.history.requeste.note: {name} is the teammate or agent who asked.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.notice.title.note: Shown while the system Touch ID prompt is open, listing what it would sign.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.notice.foreign.note: Security label on a Touch ID notice this window did not start. It may come from another program or another Local Operator window, so do not say "another program".

ui.teamBridge.approvals.notice.label.role: accessible name of the notice region

placeholders.send: how many selected requests this button would send

ui.teamBridge.approvals.approve_selected.note: Replaces "Approve selected" when some selected requests already carry an unsent Deny and so cannot be approved. Says up front how many will actually be sent.

placeholders.send: how many selected requests this button would send

ui.teamBridge.approvals.deny_selected_pa.note: Replaces "Deny selected" when some selected requests already carry an unsent Approve and so cannot be denied.

placeholders.time: localized date and time the request expires

ui.teamBridge.approvals.expires.note: Shown after "Received …" on a waiting request.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.open_card.note: Opens the chat conversation that holds this request's approval card, where it can also be answered.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.open_card_named.role: accessible name of the Open in chat button
ui.teamBridge.approvals.open_card_named.note: Screen-reader name, so several "Open in chat" buttons can be told apart.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.refusal.challeng.note: The app refused before showing Touch ID because too many confirmations were requested at once.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.refusal.unconfir.note: Touch ID succeeded but sending to the teammate failed. Rows that did not go out reappear with a "Send approval/Send denial" button.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.result.not_desig.note: The chat that raised the card is no longer the one that answers teammate requests.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.result.owner_cha.note: The Radient account bound to the chat changed since the card was raised.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.result.consent_r.note: The person withdrew consent for agent messages; nothing is sent until they give it again.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.result.item.role: one line of the results list after a decision

placeholders.word: the translated button word, Approve or Deny
placeholders.outcome: the translated per-request result, e.g. Approved or Not sent: …

ui.teamBridge.approvals.result.item.note: Keep the separators; reorder only if the language needs it.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.notice.item_appr.note: The prompt includes a request this Mac has no record of. The reader most needs to notice this line.

ui.teamBridge.approvals.notice.item_unre.note: The prompt carries a decision word the app does not recognise. Never guess approve or deny.

placeholders.count: number of decisions in that check
placeholders.time: localized date and time it ended

ui.teamBridge.approvals.trace.signed.note: A record left after a Touch ID check this window did not start was confirmed.

placeholders.count: number of decisions in that check
placeholders.time: localized date and time it ended

ui.teamBridge.approvals.trace.dismissed.note: As trace.signed, when the person cancelled the Touch ID prompt.

placeholders.count: number of decisions in that check
placeholders.time: localized date and time it ended

ui.teamBridge.approvals.trace.refused.note: As trace.signed, when the app refused the check.
